title: CASTLE DOOMENSTEIN
author: Erik Radvon
description:
Explore CASTLE DOOMENSTEIN, encounter a quickie-mart in Hell, obtain a Magical Slushie, and more in this fun and fast adventure!

CASTLE DOOMENSTEIN is my completely pointless first Interactive Fiction (IF) adventure game made using Twine!

Castle Doomenstein is a working demo that I put together while learning the basics of writing in Twine, an open source platform for constructing Interactive Fiction.

Erik Radvon
March 2016
